title: Unnamed Raytheon engineer and academic experts consulted on the Gimbal video
place_text: Off the US East Coast (Gimbal video)

tellings.quote: So, let me just run through. So, we talked to a ra a senior Rathon engineer who was, let's say, intimately familiar with the system.

plain: To make sense of the Gimbal video, a 2015 Navy cockpit recording of an object filmed off the US East Coast, a commentator named Marik von Rennenkampff says he and others consulted a senior engineer at the defence company Raytheon who was closely familiar with the camera system, along with academic experts. Von Rennenkampff tells Michels this as one of the people who did the consulting, in a debate over whether the video shows something truly unexplained.
